title: Harry Potter
premise: Magic is real, hidden just behind the ordinary world. Hogwarts accepts its next class of students. The wizarding world is full of wonders and dangers.

lore.title: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
lore.text: Castle school in the Scottish Highlands where young witches and wizards train for seven years. Moving staircases, talking portraits and ghostly teachers fill its halls, and the Great Hall hosts every feast.

lore.title: Diagon Alley
lore.text: Hidden wizard street in London, reached by tapping the right bricks behind the Leaky Cauldron. Ollivanders sells wands, Florean Fortescue scoops ice cream and Gringotts looms at the far end.

lore.title: Azkaban
lore.text: Wizard prison on a bleak island in the North Sea. Dementors guard its walls and drain the happiness out of prisoners, so even the cold feels personal. Escape is almost unheard of.

lore.title: Hogsmeade
lore.text: The only all-wizard village in Britain, sitting just outside the Hogwarts gates. Honeydukes sells sweets, the Three Broomsticks serves butterbeer, and the Shrieking Shack is said to be haunted.

lore.title: Gringotts Wizarding Bank
lore.text: Bank run by goblins beneath Diagon Alley. Vaults are reached by carts racing through underground tunnels, and the deepest vaults are rumored to be guarded by dragons.

lore.title: The Forbidden Forest
lore.text: Dense woodland that surrounds the Hogwarts grounds. Centaurs, unicorns and werewolves live beneath its canopy, and students are strictly forbidden from wandering in after dark.

lore.title: Ministry of Magic
lore.text: Britain's governing body for witches and wizards, hidden beneath the streets of London. Its departments oversee law enforcement, magical creatures and the Floo network. The Minister for Magic sits at its head.

lore.title: Order of the Phoenix
lore.text: Secret society founded by Albus Dumbledore to stand against Lord Voldemort. Members use codenames, gather at Grimmauld Place and guard their information carefully.

lore.title: Death Eaters
lore.text: Followers of Lord Voldemort who bear the Dark Mark on their forearms. They hide behind silver masks at gatherings and carry out raids, torture and murder in his name.

lore.title: The Four Hogwarts Houses
lore.text: The Sorting Hat places each student in Gryffindor for bravery, Hufflepuff for loyalty, Ravenclaw for wit or Slytherin for ambition. Each house has its own common room and fights for the house cup.

lore.title: Wand Lore
lore.text: Wands hold a magical core of unicorn hair, dragon heartstring or phoenix feather. Wands choose their wizards rather than the other way around, and the wood shapes a wand's temperament.

lore.title: Quidditch
lore.text: Flying sport played on broomsticks with seven players a side. Chasers score with the Quaffle through hoops, Beaters swing Bludgers, and the Seeker catches the Golden Snitch for 150 points.

lore.title: The Unforgivable Curses
lore.text: Three curses so dark that using one on a person earns life in Azkaban. Imperius seizes control of the mind, Cruciatus inflicts agony, and Avada Kedavra kills instantly with a flash of green light.

lore.title: Hogwarts Ghosts
lore.text: Ghosts drift through the castle as house figures and teachers' shadows: Nearly Headless Nick of Gryffindor, the Bloody Baron of Slytherin, the Fat Friar of Hufflepuff and Moaning Myrtle in a girls' bathroom.

lore.title: Floo Network
lore.text: Fireplaces across the wizarding world connect through green flames. Toss in Floo powder, state your destination clearly and you arrive in a swirl of soot. Mumble the name and you may land somewhere odd.

lore.title: Albus Dumbledore
lore.text: Headmaster of Hogwarts and Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards. Leader of the Order of the Phoenix and the wizard who defeated Grindelwald. Known for eccentric robes and lemon drops.

lore.title: Lord Voldemort
lore.text: Born Tom Marvolo Riddle, he chases immortality and power. He split his soul into Horcruxes, leads the Death Eaters and returned from defeat to threaten the wizarding world once more.

lore.title: Severus Snape
lore.text: Potions Master and Head of Slytherin House at Hogwarts. A former Death Eater who spied for Dumbledore, his loyalties are endlessly debated. Known for cutting sarcasm and the margins of a Half-Blood Prince's book.

lore.title: Rubeus Hagrid
lore.text: Keeper of Keys and Grounds at Hogwarts and teacher of Care of Magical Creatures. Half giant, with an enormous heart and a cabin near the Forbidden Forest full of very dangerous pets.

lore.title: Minerva McGonagall
lore.text: Deputy Headmistress of Hogwarts, Transfiguration professor and Head of Gryffindor House. An Animagus who can turn into a tabby cat. Strict, fair and fiercely protective of her students.

lore.title: Cornelius Fudge
lore.text: Minister for Magic during Voldemort's return, who often preferred denial to danger. Recognizable by his bowler hat, and he clashed with Dumbledore over the truth for years.
